findings.title: The live site's main phone number, (805) 460-6060, is missing everywhere
findings.why_it_matters: For a made-to-order maker, a phone call is the main way a visitor becomes an inquiry. Every call-to-action on the live site says 'call us at (805) 460-6060'. That number sits in the Atascadero Showroom address block and is printed on the owner's brochure. Our build shows only the secondary line, (805) 610-9278. If 610-9278 is a cell or fax line, calls go to the wrong place. All the benchmark sites show one clearly labelled sales or showroom line (for example, Haddonstone's Architectural Sales line 01604 770711).
findings.evidence: scraped-data.json: home, /products, /stone-colors-finishes and /faq all say 'call us at (805) 460-6060'. The footer block on every page reads 'Atascadero Showroom / 1720 El Camino Real / Atascadero, CA 93422 / (805) 460-6060', then '(805) 610-9278' on its own line. scraped-content/BRAND-CONTENT.md:418-419 lists both. The build uses only 610-9278, in src/app/layout.tsx:136, src/app/contact/page.tsx:57, src/app/faq/page.tsx:138, src/components/InquiryForm.tsx:23 and src/components/StructuredData.tsx:12. Commit 4a6fd07 picked 610-9278 without recording why. The photo technical-info_get-details2_2.png shows a printed 101 brochure carrying '460-6060'.
findings.proposal: Until the owner confirms, show both numbers the way the live site does. Put '(805) 460-6060' first, labelled 'Showroom', with tel:+18054606060, in the footer, on /contact, in the FAQ 'Still have a question?' block and in the InquiryForm fallback panel. Keep (805) 610-9278 as the second line. Set StructuredData telephone to +1-805-460-6060. Then ask the owner which number is primary and what 610-9278 is.
findings.source_for_any_new_copy: https://www.101caststone.com (footer: 'Atascadero Showroom ... (805) 460-6060' / '(805) 610-9278'); https://www.101caststone.com/faq ('Please call us at (805) 460-6060')

findings.title: 'Est. 2001' and 'nationwide' contradict the owner's own About page, which says 2006
findings.why_it_matters: On the benchmark sites, trust rests on facts a buyer can check: Haddonstone cites UKCSA membership and British Standards, and Continental Cast Stone appears on DOT approved-manufacturer lists. Architects and builders often look up a contractor licence. A founding year that disagrees with the owner's own published history, or with the licence record, undermines every other claim on the site.
findings.evidence: Scraped /about-us: 'Clark Baird started 101 Cast Stone in the summer of 2006.' The build says 2001 in src/app/layout.tsx:16 (meta description 'Serving California since 2001'), :97 (header 'Maison California · Est. 2001') and :126 (footer). src/components/StructuredData.tsx:10 has 'since 2001' and :14 has foundingDate '2001'. src/app/contact/page.tsx:81 says 'Serving California and nationwide since 2001.' 'Nationwide' appears in no source. The 2001 comes from scraped-content/BRAND-CONTENT.md:412. Commit 2ce4fe7 already left the year off /about 'pending the owner's 2001-vs-2006 call', but the header, footer, schema and contact page still show it.
findings.proposal: Remove the year in every place until the owner decides. Header and footer become 'Maison California'. Delete foundingDate and 'since 2001' from StructuredData and the layout metadata. Replace the contact-page italic line with 'Factory showroom in Atascadero. Weekend appointments available.' (sourced). Also make the licence verifiable: on /about and in the footer, link 'license #892542' to the state lookup at https://www.cslb.ca.gov/OnlineServices/CheckLicenseII/LicenseDetail.aspx?LicNum=892542, with no added claims about the licence class.
findings.source_for_any_new_copy: https://www.101caststone.com/about-us ('started 101 Cast Stone in the summer of 2006'); footer of every scraped page ('Factory Showroom Hours ... Weekend Appointments Available', 'License #892542')

findings.title: No page per product: 25 products live only as #hash dialogs on one /collections page
findings.why_it_matters: Leading makers give every design its own URL with its photos and specs (Haddonstone /prod/<slug>/; Chesney's per-model pages; François & Co's Modeno listing). Searchers find these pages, designers forward them to clients, and later the owner's dimensions will have a home there. Search engines ignore #fragments, so our 25 products currently have no indexable pages. The live site's product URLs (/heritage, /provence, /royal-acanthus …) are also 301-redirected to fragments, which merges all their search equity into /collections.
findings.evidence: src/app/collections/page.tsx is one 'use client' page that opens ProductModal through the URL hash. src/app/sitemap.ts lists 8 URLs and no products. next.config.js:25-59 redirects about 30 live URLs to '/collections#<slug>' (for example ...to('/collections#heritage', ['/heritage'])). Benchmarks: https://www.haddonstone.com/en-us/prod/tudor-fireplace-excluding-shields-including-hearth/ (overall 1485×1220×165 mm, opening 1120×1035 mm); https://www.materialbank.com/francois-co-modeno-2271877 (S/M/L/XL sizes with recommended firebox fits).
findings.proposal: Add src/app/collections/[slug]/page.tsx using generateStaticParams over productSlugs. Each page shows the product's gallery through the existing PhotoGallery (6 photos now; the live pages hold more, for example 22 for Provence and 16 for Heritage in media-map.json), its description, the style group, the existing 'Available Options' list and the 'Inquire About This Piece' CTA. Add 3 related pieces from the same style or collection, per-product metadata and OG image, and Product JSON-LD with no price. Leave a typed `specs?` slot that stays empty until the owner sends dimensions. Change the next.config.js redirects to /collections/<slug> and add the slugs to sitemap.ts. Cards and the dialog can stay; the dialog can link 'Open full page'.
findings.source_for_any_new_copy: No new copy. Reuses src/data/products.ts, plus the 'Available Options' strings already sourced from /products ('standard and custom styles and dimensions', 'seven colors and three texture finishes') and /faq.

findings.title: No architect and builder resources page; the live /technical-info URL lands on the FAQ
findings.why_it_matters: Architects and builders specify from technical packages. Haddonstone gives away CAD drawings, product schedules and installation guidelines and keeps a resources archive. Continental Cast Stone is listed on Sweets with CAD, BIM and spec sections. The Cast Stone Institute publishes Section 04 72 00 specs, typical details and color guidance. Our owner already has three named documents 'for consumers, architects and installers'. The build lists them only on /about, and that page isn't in the build currently served on :3001.
findings.evidence: Scraped /technical-info: 'Drawings, Worksheets and Brochures: Fireplace Surround Worksheet; Cast Stone Product Installation sheet; Cast Stone Fireplace Installation sheet' and 'Technical documents for consumers, architects and installers.' next.config.js:58 sends /technical-info to /faq (temporary redirect). Only src/app/about/page.tsx:51 lists the three documents ('Request the documents' → /contact?product=Technical%20documents). curl localhost:3001/about returns 404 because the served build predates commit 2ce4fe7. No PDF URLs exist in scraped-data.json (grep '.pdf' finds nothing). Benchmarks: architectsdatafile.co.uk/?p=311424 (Haddonstone: 'quotations, detailed CAD drawings, product schedules, and installation guidelines, all at no extra cost'); haddonstone.com/en-gb/llms.txt (Resources Archive); sweets.construction.com Continental listing; caststone.org/technical-resources.
findings.proposal: Create /technical-info (keeps the live URL) and title it 'For Architects, Builders & Installers'. List each of the three documents with its own 'Request' button prefilled as ?product=<document name>. Add the sourced trade facts: standard and custom styles and dimensions; 7 colors and 3 textures, custom colors on request; new or modified molds made in the in-house mold shop; fireplace products quoted with installation by our team, and others may install 'as long as our installation requirements are adhered to'; non-combustible next to the firebox opening; California contractor license #892542; the builder and public-sector names from the client list. Remove the /technical-info → /faq redirect and add the page to the sitemap and footer. When the owner sends the PDFs, swap the Request buttons for direct downloads.
findings.source_for_any_new_copy: https://www.101caststone.com/technical-info; https://www.101caststone.com/products; https://www.101caststone.com/faq ('Who installs…', 'What is the Fireplace Mantel made of?'); https://www.101caststone.com/design-manufacturing-process (step 4, Custom Mold Shop); https://www.101caststone.com/about-us (client list)

findings.title: No firebox-fit guidance or site-measure path, though the owner's FAQ offers both
findings.why_it_matters: Fit is the first question for any mantel buyer. The benchmarks lead with it: Haddonstone and Chesney's list opening W×H on every fireplace, François & Co gives recommended firebox fits per size, and Mantels Direct publishes a fitting guide. We can't publish dimensions yet. We can publish the owner's sourced answer: a free-to-ask local site visit to verify measurements, a worksheet for out-of-area buyers, and mantels that can be altered to fit.
findings.evidence: Scraped /faq: 'If you are local to our area of California, our sales staff will schedule an appointment to visit your residence or jobsite to verify the measurements. If you are out of the area, please download our Fireplace Surround Worksheet…' and 'If the fireplace mantel you desire does not appear to fit your firebox, we can work with our design team… to alter the mantel in such a manner that will retain the integrity of the design.' In the build this text sits only in collapsed FAQ items (src/app/faq/page.tsx). ProductModal 'Available Options' (src/components/ProductModal.tsx:80-95) and the inquiry form (src/lib/inquiry.ts fields) say nothing about sizing. Benchmarks: mantelsdirect.com classic-cast-stone-fitting-guide; materialbank.com/francois-co-modeno-2271877.
findings.proposal: Add a short 'Sizing your mantel' block to every mantel product dialog or page and to /contact. Text: 'Local to our area: our sales staff will visit to verify measurements. Out of the area: ask for our Fireplace Surround Worksheet; we review it with you to confirm accuracy. If your firebox doesn't fit a standard mantel, our design team can alter it while keeping the design's integrity.' Buttons: 'Request a measuring visit' (?product=Measuring%20visit) and 'Request the worksheet' (?product=Fireplace%20Surround%20Worksheet). In InquiryForm, add optional 'Firebox opening, width × height (if known)' and a checkbox 'I'd like a measuring visit (local projects)'. Both are field labels, not claims.
findings.source_for_any_new_copy: https://www.101caststone.com/faq ('How do I measure my Fireplace?', 'What if the firebox opening does not seem to fit the standard mantel dimensions?')

findings.title: /process and /commissions show an invented 6–12-week timeline; the owner's FAQ says 2–3 weeks
findings.why_it_matters: Clear lead times are part of the benchmarks' process story (Old World Stoneworks: custom orders '4-8 weeks+'; Haddonstone shows each production step). A fast lead time on a handmade product would be a selling point for us. Instead the build hides the sourced figure and shows made-up, longer ones, and anyone who reads both pages sees the contradiction.
findings.evidence: src/app/process/page.tsx:30-36 'Timeline': 'Custom mould creation: 2-4 weeks / Casting and curing: 3-6 weeks / Hand finishing and detailing: 1-2 weeks'. Also :21-27 'Materials sourced for permanence and patina. Mockups and moulds engineered before pour…' src/app/commissions/page.tsx:16 still lists '2-4 week design phase' in the working tree, plus the 4-step 'Commission Process' text ('Applied patinas where appropriate', 'Mineral aggregates'). Sources: /faq 'please allow 2 to 3 weeks for production and installation of your fireplace mantel'; /design-manufacturing-process step 6 'The molds are then left to dry for approximately one day'. src/app/faq/page.tsx:20 deliberately leaves out the lead time 'until the owner reconciles'.
findings.proposal: Delete the invented Timeline and Materials lists on /process, and the '2-4 week design phase' bullet and the invented phase text on /commissions. Replace them with the live site's 8 numbered steps, already condensed to 6 at process/page.tsx:42-49. Add the sourced material sentence: 'Cast stone is mixed in the color you specify and packed by hand into the mold; a fiberglass mix is then packed by hand behind it; molds dry for approximately one day depending on the detail.' Once the owner confirms, add 'Fireplace mantels: please allow 2 to 3 weeks for production and installation' to /process, the mantel dialogs and the FAQ.
findings.source_for_any_new_copy: https://www.101caststone.com/design-manufacturing-process (steps 1–8); https://www.101caststone.com/faq ('What is the lead time for my mantel?')

findings.title: Thin portfolio: /works shows 9 photos while 215 unused project photos exist
findings.why_it_matters: Strong cast stone sites show many real installations: Haddonstone has named residential case studies (Oxfordshire Georgian new build with a four-column portico and pool balustrade; Kent; Houston, Texas). For buyers spending heavily, the number and range of real installs is the strongest evidence after the product itself. Our owner has years of real work photos that the site doesn't use.
findings.evidence: src/app/works/page.tsx has 9 photos with no categories. media-map.json 'gallery' has 313 photos, 215 of them not on any product page; contact sheets are in discovery/benchmark/gal_0..3.jpg. The 215 include, by eye: about 120 interior cast stone mantels, about 50 stone-veneer and masonry fireplace walls, about 15 outdoor fireplaces and kitchens, plus arched entries, kitchen hoods, pavers in grass, a carved bench, a wood-fired oven, a pergola, and a crew moving a large bowl on a pallet. The client list (Daou Winery, City of Atascadero, City of Paso Robles, Shea Homes, Midland Pacific Builders…) appears only on /about. Benchmarks: haddonstone.com/case-studies/private-residence-oxfordshire/, /private-residence-kent/, caddetails.com Houston TX project.
findings.proposal: Rebuild /works as a filterable grid (Mantels · Stone masonry · Outdoor fire & kitchens · Entries & trims · Hoods · Fountains & garden) of 60–90 finished-installation photos chosen from the 215, captioned only by what is visible (as works/page.tsx:12 already does). Load lazily with the existing PhotoGallery lightbox. Each category ends with an 'Inquire' link prefilled with the category. Add a text-only 'Selected clients' strip (no logos) from the About list to /works and the home page. Named case studies, such as whether the live /daou page photos were taken at Daou Winery, wait for the owner to confirm.
findings.source_for_any_new_copy: Captions describe the photos only. Client names from https://www.101caststone.com/about-us ('Here's just a few of our past and current customers').

findings.title: Scraped photos are Wix-resized crops (about 600–800 px of real detail); the uncropped originals are on Wix
findings.why_it_matters: Leading sites use large, sharp photography. Ours is upscaled: it looks soft in the /works 21:9 feature, the home masonry tiles and on retina screens. The originals sit at a known URL for each media id, so this is a fetch, not a reshoot.
findings.evidence: scraped-data.json allImages: all 669 originalUrls use Wix transforms such as '/v1/fill/w_280,h_280' for the gallery thumbnails and '/v1/fill/w_561,h_434' for the 'fill' crops (median longest side 561 px outside the gallery). A round-trip detail test (discovery/benchmark/res3.js) flattens at about 800 px for public/images/products/heritage/01.jpg (1400²), gallery/works-1.jpg (1905×1361) and gallery/project-1.jpg (1920²). A 1:1 crop of gallery …00fb5081…_mv2_227.jpg (g1_crop.jpg) is visibly soft. This network blocks fetching originals (curl to static.wixstatic.com → CONNECT 403; WebFetch ENOTFOUND).
findings.proposal: For the roughly 100 media ids the build uses (public/images/products/*, gallery/*, process/*, finishes/*), download https://static.wixstatic.com/media/<id>~mv2.<ext> with no /v1/ transform. That returns the original upload, uncropped. Alternatively the owner can export them from Wix Media Manager. Re-run the existing curation crops against the originals. This needs a session with outbound access to static.wixstatic.com, or the owner.

findings.title: Only 3 of the 7 standard colors are named; the full chart is probably in the uncropped Wix original
findings.why_it_matters: Leading sites name and code their standard colors and offer physical samples (Haddonstone: Portland 01, Bath 02, Terracotta 04, a free sample form and a color-matching service). The Cast Stone Institute advises 'requesting samples from your producer before finalizing your specification.' Saying 'seven standard colors' while showing three makes the selection look unfinished.
findings.evidence: src/data/products.ts stoneColors has Limestone, Bisque and Carmel Sand. The collections copy says 'Three of the seven standard colors are shown.' The scraped chart's originalUrl is '…/d303e4_d290c8809e3f4ea4b84354d1c036e4a1~mv2.png/v1/fill/w_464,h_301,al_c/cast-stone-colors.png', a centre crop. In discovery/benchmark/colors.jpg the edge labels are cut off: '…ND', 'OA…', '…STONE', 'MOCH…'. The build's contact page says 'visit… to view samples', which appears in no source. Benchmarks: haddonstone.com/request-stone-colour-sample/, haddonstone.com/en/choosing-colour, caststone.org/typical-colors.
findings.proposal: (1) Fetch https://static.wixstatic.com/media/d303e4_d290c8809e3f4ea4b84354d1c036e4a1~mv2.png untransformed. If all seven labels are legible, crop the 4 missing swatches and add them to stoneColors. Never guess names from the cut-off fragments. (2) Ask the owner whether physical color and texture samples can be seen at the showroom or mailed. If yes, add a 'Request a sample' CTA on #finishes (?product=Color%20sample). If no, remove 'to view samples' from contact/page.tsx:81.
findings.source_for_any_new_copy: https://www.101caststone.com/stone-colors-finishes ('Shown below are our standard colors and finishes. We can also produce custom colors and texture finishes'); the color names must come from the original chart image.

findings.title: The factory showroom isn't presented as a place to visit
findings.why_it_matters: Haddonstone's US showroom is a permanent display at its Pueblo, Colorado production facility, with its own 'Visit Haddonstone' page. Chesney's built a separate architectural showroom with a design service for architects and designers. Our owner also has a factory showroom with weekday hours and weekend appointments, which suits weekend-only homeowners. The build calls it a 'Studio' and offers no visit or appointment action.
findings.evidence: The live footer on every page says 'Atascadero Showroom' and 'Factory Showroom Hours: Monday-Friday: 8am to 5pm / Weekend Appointments Available'. The build labels it 'Studio Location' (contact/page.tsx:41) and 'Studio' (layout.tsx footer). Only /about:140 says 'Visit the Atascadero showroom', and /about isn't in the served build. src/lib/inquiry.ts PROJECT_TYPE_OPTIONS has no showroom or appointment option. Benchmarks: haddonstone.com/en-us/llms.txt ('Visit Haddonstone' Colorado showroom); stonespecialist.com 'Chesney's opens new showroom for architectural stone'.
findings.proposal: Rename 'Studio' to 'Factory Showroom' in the footer and on /contact. Add a 'Visit the factory showroom' band to the home page above the final CTA, using the existing workshop-floor.jpg ('The manufacturing floor'), the address, the hours, 'Weekend appointments available', a 'Request a weekend appointment' button (/contact?product=Showroom%20appointment) and the existing directions link. Add 'Showroom visit' to PROJECT_TYPE_OPTIONS. A photo of the showroom display itself needs the owner: none of the scraped pages show one.
findings.source_for_any_new_copy: Footer of every scraped page ('Atascadero Showroom', 'Factory Showroom Hours', 'Weekend Appointments Available')

findings.title: The inquiry form doesn't capture what a quote needs and promises an unsourced response time
findings.why_it_matters: On the benchmark sites, the first exchange produces a quote and drawings (Haddonstone sends quotations and CAD drawings for approval; François & Co sends a formal drawing reflecting site conditions). For us to quote a mantel, the owner's process needs the firebox, the installation choice and the color or texture. Asking for them up front cuts a round of email and identifies serious buyers.
findings.evidence: src/lib/inquiry.ts:20-29 has the fields name, email, phone, role, projectType, product, location, timeline and message. There's no file upload; photos are pushed to email at contact/page.tsx:95-103. 'We typically respond within 1–2 business days' appears at InquiryForm.tsx (result panel and :209) and ProductModal.tsx:111 and has no source. Sourced process: /design-manufacturing-process step 2 'Our Sales & Design professionals will work with you to determine the … project requirements'; /faq 'All of our fireplace products are quoted with installation… many of our products may be installed by others'.
findings.proposal: Add optional fields: 'Firebox opening W × H (if known)' (shown when projectType is Fireplace mantel); 'Installation' with options By 101 Cast Stone / By my installer / Not sure; 'Texture' with options Classic / Old World / Rustic / Not sure; 'Color' with the named swatches plus Not sure. Add photo or drawing attachments to /api/inquiry (Resend supports attachments; cap at 3 files of 5 MB each). Remove the '1–2 business days' line unless the owner confirms it.
findings.source_for_any_new_copy: Field labels only. Option values come from https://www.101caststone.com/stone-colors-finishes (Classic, Old World, Rustic) and /faq (installation by our team or by others).

findings.title: No material and care spec on product views, though the owner's FAQ has one
findings.why_it_matters: Specifiers want to know what a product is made of and how to look after it. Haddonstone publishes its standards, frost-resistance testing and assembly sheets, and the Cast Stone Institute frames cast stone around ASTM C1364. Our owner's FAQ gives the mix, non-combustibility, sealing and cleaning. In the build that information is either buried in collapsed FAQ items or left out.
findings.evidence: Scraped /faq: 'Included in the mix are Portland Cement, Crushed Quartz, Color Pigment, Fiberglass Reinforcing Materials and Polymer'; 'Sealing is recommended but not required. Cast Stone products are porous and therefore subject to staining. We can provide you with the appropriate sealer…'; 'With lukewarm water and a clean white cloth.'; 'if you wish to have an artist antique or faux finish the mantel, our products will accept their materials.' src/app/faq/page.tsx:20 leaves out the whole 'made of' answer. Only its comparison claims ('much stronger', 'much cheaper', 'over 70 years') need the owner. Benchmarks: haddonstone.com/guest-blog-neil-sparrow-is-my-cast-stone-frost-resistant/; caststone.org/specifications.
findings.proposal: Add a 'Material & care' block under 'Available Options' in ProductModal and on the planned product pages and /technical-info. Material: Portland cement, crushed quartz, color pigment, fiberglass reinforcement and polymer, packed by hand in Atascadero. Non-combustible (mantels). Sealing recommended, not required; sealer available at installation. Clean with lukewarm water and a clean white cloth. Accepts artist antique or faux finishes. Add the ingredient sentence back to the FAQ as 'What is cast stone made of?' without the comparison claims.
findings.source_for_any_new_copy: https://www.101caststone.com/faq ('What is the Fireplace Mantel made of?', 'Do I need to seal…', 'How do I clean…', 'Is there a finish required?')

findings.title: No dimensions or standard opening sizes for any mantel (owner data needed)
findings.why_it_matters: This is the biggest product-presentation gap against the benchmarks. Haddonstone lists overall W×H×D, opening W×H and hearth size (Tudor HF610W: 1485×1220×165 mm, opening 1120×1035). Chesney's lists overall, opening and shelf depth (Nash: 1430×1253 mm, opening 1016×1016, shelf 1600×215). François & Co lists four sizes with recommended firebox fits. Without numbers, architects can't draw the piece in and homeowners can't tell whether it fits.
findings.evidence: The live product pages hold no dimensions; each scraped mantel page's content is only navigation and footer, 744 characters. src/data/products.ts has no size fields. Benchmarks: haddonstone.com/en-us/prod/tudor-fireplace-excluding-shields-including-hearth/; topstak.co.uk/fire-surrounds/regency-collection/the-nash/; materialbank.com/francois-co-modeno-2271877; downloads.hearthnhome.com/brochures/fsf_mantels_brochure.pdf (opening and outside W/H, leg and shelf depth tables).
findings.proposal: Ask the owner for each of the 11 catalogue mantels (and for Casa Blanca and Barcelona, see the next finding): overall width × height; shelf length × depth; leg width and depth; standard opening width × height; number of pieces and approximate weight; any standard size variants. For hoods, columns and balustrades, ask for standard heights, diameters and rail lengths. Render these as a 'Dimensions' table with an 'Altered to fit your firebox on request' footnote (sourced from the FAQ). Optionally also ask for a one-page drawing per mantel for /technical-info.
findings.source_for_any_new_copy: Owner-supplied data only; footnote from https://www.101caststone.com/faq

findings.title: Mantel catalogue: no style grouping, and two live-site designs plus the limestone offer are missing
findings.why_it_matters: Chesney's organises its range by period (Georgian, Regency, French, Contemporary), and the owner's own site groups mantels the same way: Contemporary, Traditional, Old World, Custom, Outdoor. Grouping speeds up choosing among 11 mantels. Two named designs and a natural-limestone service aimed at high-end buyers aren't represented.
findings.evidence: Scraped /fireplace-mantels-1 menu: 'CONTEMPORARY: Contemporary Surround, Genoa · TRADITONAL: Heritage, Milagro, Pacifica, Provence, Santa Barbara · OLD WORLD: Royal Acanthus, Cambridge, Chateau, Casa Blanca, Tangled, Barcelona · CUSTOM: Custom Ordered Limestone Installations; Cast Stone (101 manufactured) · OUTDOOR: Fireplaces, Firepits'. The working tree now has 11 mantels with style tags (products.ts) but shows them as one flat grid. Casa Blanca and Barcelona have no scraped page or photos. grep finds no 'limestone install' in src. Benchmark: brochures.chesneys.co.uk/luxury-fired-by-design-us (Historical, Contemporary, Victorian, Regency, Georgian, French collections).
findings.proposal: On /collections#mantels, add sub-headings or filter chips for Contemporary, Traditional and Old World, ordered as on the live menu, using the existing `style` field. Add a 'Custom' line to the mantel intro: 'Custom ordered limestone installations, or a custom configuration of our current designs' (both sourced). Ask the owner for photos and descriptions of Casa Blanca and Barcelona, and for what 'Custom Ordered Limestone Installations' includes.
findings.source_for_any_new_copy: https://www.101caststone.com/fireplace-mantels-1 (menu groups and labels); https://www.101caststone.com/design-manufacturing-process step 1 ('custom configuration utilizing our current stock or generate something completely new')

findings.title: Trust and transparency items only the owner can supply: warranty, testing, reviews, pricing, brochure
findings.why_it_matters: Leading sites back their claims with external evidence. Haddonstone cites a five-year warranty on garden ornaments in one older document, products that exceed BS 1217 and BS EN 13198, and TecStone passing more than 250 freeze-thaw cycles. Continental appears on DOT approved-manufacturer lists that require ASTM C1364. Old World Stoneworks shows third-party reviews and a free installation video. Chesney's publishes 'from' prices through dealers and an online brochure with a dimensions guide. Our live site's /testimonials page is empty, and the site has no warranty, test data or prices.
findings.evidence: Scraped /testimonials holds only footer text (278 characters). findings.proposal: Owner checklist: (1) any written warranty or guarantee; (2) any ASTM C1364, C1194 or C1195 test results, or Cast Stone Institute membership; (3) permission to quote 3–6 named client testimonials, or a link to Google or Houzz reviews; (4) whether to show indicative 'from' prices for installed mantels; (5) the brochure as a PDF; (6) photos of the showroom display and the team; (7) whether 'We typically respond within 1–2 business days' is a promise the owner will keep. Each item gets a set place in the site once supplied: the /technical-info page, the product pages, the home trust band and /about.
